issues.issue: Line mixes property tax with state aid and other taxes: p7 shows County treasurer receipts 74,326 + Property tax credit 7,869 + Motor vehicle pro rate 133 + Carline 177 = 82,505, and p8 shows the county collections include motor vehicle taxes 12,574 and homestead 4,438. Property tax is the dominant part, so the category holds, but the line has no review note naming the mix.

Line mixes licenses and fees (actual 36,667 against a 1,640 budget, p7), so fees may dominate. It has no review note, though the same kind of line is flagged in other reports. detail[8] has the same issue.

issues.on_page: Schedule of County Treasurer's Fund (allocated to General)
issues.issue: Possible double counting across schedules. The County Treasurer's Fund belongs to the General Fund (p8 allocates its ending balance to General), and its Property tax credit 7,869, Motor vehicle prorate 133 and Carline 177 (detail[37], detail[36], detail[39]) also appear as separate lines in the p7 all-funds schedule (detail[4], detail[6], detail[7]). The p8 Transfer to Village Treasurer 81,496 is the same money that comes in as County treasurer receipts on p7/p4. The extractor disclosed this in its notes; a person should decide whether p8 stays in detail.
